name: chalkreel
description: Learning objective in, accessible explainer video out. An agent-skill package: objective gate, sourced research, humanized narration, code-drawn Remotion frames, word-aligned subtitles, full accessibility bundle, and Mayer-principle QC with 4 human approval gates.

scripts.test:objective-gate: node skill/scripts/objective-gate.mjs "Given a patient case file, second-year nursing students will classify the arrhythmia using the ACLS algorithm, correctly for at least 4 of 5 cases."
scripts.test:lint-negative: node skill/scripts/lint-narration.mjs skill/examples/bad-narration.txt && echo 'UNEXPECTED PASS' || echo 'OK: bad narration was rejected (exit code above)'
scripts.test:a11y-negative: node skill/scripts/a11y-lint.mjs skill/examples/bad-storyboard.json && echo 'UNEXPECTED PASS' || echo 'OK: bad storyboard was rejected'
scripts.test: npm run test:objective-gate && npm run test:lint-positive && npm run test:srt && npm run test:transcript && npm run test:a11y
